messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — routing anomalies observed in eu-west-1. Spike in fallbacks and mismatched model variants. Paging @eve (oncall) and @mike (sre).

eve: on it. seeing repeated `variant=rwd-large-qa` being selected for low-latency routes that should be `rwd-small-lowlat`.

mike: logs show a config push earlier that touched routing schema. suspect deprecated field handling.

alice: confirm — I rolled the schema PR `infra/routing#842` 12m ago. It removed `preferred_region` and added `region_policy`. migration script ran but probably left legacy fields in some tenant configs.

sam: customer-impact update: support flagged 3 customers in EU with high latency + poor answer quality — ACME, BexCo, and a small fintech. tickets 8241/8242/8243.

eve: good to know. immediate mitigations: 1) stop further schema rollouts 2) add a temporary routing override to force eu requests to `rwd-small-lowlat` 3) revert migration for affected tenant bucket. will try (2) first for fastest rollback.

mike: how do we force override? can we push a policy that maps region->variant explicitly?

alice: yes, we can use the policy patch API. example:

```
POST /admin/policies/patch
{
  "selector": {"region": "eu-west-1", "tier": "prod"},
  "patch": {"routing": {"variant": "rwd-small-lowlat", "enforce": true}}
}
```

I can apply a patch scoped to the affected tenant bucket. deploying now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: policy-patch-eu-force (job 6721) — started by alice.

mike: also adding a temporary alert: count(fallbacks) > 50 / 5m in eu-west -> page.

incident-bot: Annotated event: fallback-loop-detected. metric anomaly (fallback rate up 220% in 10m).

alice: patch applied. verifying traffic. initial checks: fallback rate dropping from 18% -> 4% over 3mins.

eve: seeing variant ratios normalize on the monitoring dashboard. latency trending down.

sam: customers updating — ACME confirms reduced latency and responses looking correct now. thanks.

karen: customer-success note: ACME wants root cause and ETA for permanent fix. they flagged SLA impacts.

eve: brief RCA in-thread: during schema change we introduced a new `region_policy` object and intentionally allowed legacy `preferred_region` for backwards compatibility. however, when both fields existed in a tenant config the code path favored the legacy field but the migration left `preferred_region` empty/`null` for some tenants. the routing fallback logic treats `null` as a signal to use global defaults which includes an older variant mapping that picks `rwd-large-qa`. result: EU prod traffic got mapped to wrong variant and then spun into region fallback loops when capacity mismatched, causing retries and higher latencies.

mike: tl;dr: a null/empty deprecated field ended up with unexpected default semantics.

alice: timeline: PR merged at 11:03 UTC, migration job at 11:05, first alerts at 11:17, mitigation patch at 11:28. total customer impact window ~ 12 minutes.

eve: handoff — I'll keep this as active incident. @mike you own the infrastructure fix (prevent migrations leaving nulls and add strict validation). @alice own safe schema rollback path + migration re-run script. @sam/karen coordinate customer comms.

mike: immediate action items I will do now: 1) emergency alert to catch `deprecated_field_present && value == null` 2) add a migration validation step that fails loud if any legacy field is left null 3) add unit test for policy selection precedence.

alice: migration follow-ups: write a backfill that converts null `preferred_region` to explicit `region_policy: {mode: "inherit"}` for compatibility. schedule Postmortem.

sam: shared a customer note draft, will wait for final RCA before sending.

karen: agree. include apology + mitigation summary + timeline + next steps. request follow-up in 24 hours.

incident-bot: Incident tagged: routing-policy-misconfig. severity: P2. attachments: metrics snapshot, affected-tenant-list (internal).

eve: closing notes for now — monitoring for 2h. if counts spike we re-open and escalate to P1.

mike: also adding synthetic tests that hit variant mapping logic across region permutations to catch this class of bugs pre-merge.

alice: will revert the risky part of the schema change in `infra/routing` and re-run migrations with validation.

sam: will update the three customers after RCA is drafted.

eve: oncall handoff: @mike you'll be primary for the next 6 hours — please ack and monitor.

mike: ack. I'll post status updates to this thread every 30m until stable. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy finished: policy-patch-eu-force (job 6721) — success.

incident-bot: Note: create follow-up task in backlog: "routing schema migration guardrails" and link to this thread.

mike: closing remark — root cause wasn't a hardware or kernel bug, it was a migration + legacy-default semantics mismatch. easy to miss but high runtime impact. we should treat deprecated-field->null as a class of critical invariants.

eve: agreed. good work team.
